errors.evidence: The chart title says "Индустрия (с изкл. на строителството)", which means "Industry (excluding construction)". The description incorrectly states "изключително строителството", which means "exclusively construction", the opposite of the title.
The chart clearly shows two lines: a solid blue line representing the data and a dotted blue line, likely a trendline. The description only mentions one line.

errors.text_span: Оста X представлява времеви периоди, разположени равномерно с интервали от 1 година, като началната точка е 0 и крайната е 5.
errors.evidence: The X-axis has no title, labels, or tick marks with values. The description invents a range from 0 to 5 and an interval of 1 year, which are not visually present on the chart.

errors.text_span: с плътна линия и маркери във формата на точки
errors.evidence: The description inaccurately combines features of the two different lines shown. There is a solid line (плътна линия) and a separate dotted line (линия с точки), not one solid line with dot markers.
The line starts at a value of approximately 36.5, not 37.0.
The description misrepresents the line's trend. While it does pass near 31.0, its lowest point (trough) is at approximately 29.5, which is completely missed.
The line ends at a value of approximately 31.5, not 32.0.

errors.text_span: Върховете са приблизително при 0, 2 и 5 години.
errors.evidence: This incorrectly identifies the peaks ("Върховете"). There is an initial peak at the first data point (year 0), but the point at "year 2" is part of a decline/plateau, not a peak. The point at "year 5" is the end of the series, not necessarily a peak.
This is grammatically incorrect. "върхове" is plural, but the phrase structure requires a singular noun ("връх").
